newsitem.title: UK: March Brent system throughput up from Feb - Shell.
newsitem.headline: March Brent system throughput up from Feb - Shell.

text.p: Shell Exploration and Production (Shell Expro) on Wednesday estimated North Sea Brent crude system throughput in March would average 498,972 barrels a day (bpd), up from February's 479,667 bpd.
Average Brent pipeline supply in the 12 months to the end of January was 507,337 bpd.

Brent system throughput includes crude produced from 13 fields and several satellite wells piped to the Sullom Voe terminal in the Shetland islands for blending with Ninian crude and exported as Brent blend.
Shell Expro is a joint venture between Royal Dutch/Shell Group and and Exxon Corp.
Shell said the throughput forecast was preliminary and may be "subject to significant fluctuation."
